visualCharacteristics.purpose: brand heritage band: image | centred title, text, CTA | image with signature
visualCharacteristics.description: White, faded red pattern background image (heritage_bg) with red stripes on top; Colonel image left, centered red 'HERITAGE' title, paragraph and red CTA 'Despre noi' in the middle, image + signature on the right.

contentPattern.structure: one row, three cells; cell 1 = image only; cell 2 = heading, paragraph, CTA link; cell 3 = image plus optional second image (signature)
contentPattern.description: Side-by-side three-column layout (image | text | image + signature) over a decorative pattern background that belongs to the block.

usage: Heritage / about teaser. The decorative pattern background is added in the design pass.
reuseGuidance: Use for a centred text column flanked by two image columns. On mobile the text column is shown first.
